title: Chapter 265: Rule-Level Power Self-Destructs
content:
Chapter 265: Rule-Level Power Self-Destructs

Wu Qing no longer kept secret some of the abilities of the Zerg that needed to be hidden before.

Those Light Griffin Knights will soon be exposed. There is no need to hide the ability of the Zerg to control the armies of other races.

Moreover, after this battle, the Zerg will be able to lay a foundation here and no longer need to care about the fear of other races.

The more others fear the Zerg, the more conducive it is to spread the reputation of the Zerg.

The terrible thing about the Zerg Queen's parasitic control on the battlefield is that the enemy needs to divide a part of their energy to keep an eye on their companions at all times. The companions around them may turn against them at any time, which is a fatal blow to an army.

The soldiers of the alien army, no matter how firm their faith is, it is useless. The parasitic control of the Zerg Queen uses biotechnology, not mental control, and willpower alone cannot resist it.

As more and more alien armies turn against them and kill crazily in the large formation of the alien army, the alien army, which was originally able to maintain an orderly state under various attacks, finally began to become chaotic.

The Zerg flying dragon group in the sky joined the battle and assisted the Zerg puppy to break through the defense line of the alien army.

Under the control of the Queen, Zerg Explosive Swarms of various star strengths self-destructed at various important positions of the alien army, further disrupting the formation of the alien army.

Zerg Destroyers, Zerg Explosive Swarms, Zerg Queens and Zerg Dragons cooperated to assist Zerg Puppies in breaking through the defense lines of the alien army, disrupting the formation of the entire alien army, and making it impossible for the alien army to organize large-scale effective defense and counterattacks.

The Zerg army continued to compress the defense space of the alien army, and a large number of alien army soldiers died and turned into light in various attacks of the Zerg army.

The speed of the alien space transmission channel to transmit troops has completely failed to keep up with the speed of troop consumption on the battlefield.

A large number of reinforced Zerg Puppies began to outflanking and gradually surrounded the alien army.

With the strong support of other arms, the Zerg Puppies continued to break through the defense lines of the alien army, interspersed and advanced, and slowly divided the alien army from a whole into many small pieces.

"The Zerg has already exerted its strength, and the alien race is powerless to turn the tide!"

"We have always thought that the Zerg's troops are precious, but now we find that the Zerg has the most and cheapest troops!"

"The Zerg's melee troops are estimated to have exceeded 20 million, and the number is still increasing!"

"The cooperation of the various arms of the Zerg army is seamless. Now they have melee troops that are not afraid of sacrifice, which makes up for their lack of troops. The alien race has met a real opponent!"

"The outcome of this battle is determined. Let's see the final performance of the Zerg!"

"..."

Observers from all forces in the local camp have confirmed the victory of the Zerg, and they are all waiting for the final result.

Wu Qing also decided to end this war quickly. Don't be too greedy in everything, and know when to stop.

A large number of Zerg explosive mosquitoes flew over the space transmission channel of the alien race and launched a self-destruction attack on the light attribute energy shield that has been covering the space where the space transmission channel is located.

"Boom boom boom!"

The terrible self-destruction attack of the Zerg Explosive Mosquito caused the light attribute energy shield to flicker continuously. The nearby alien army was affected by the explosion and suffered heavy casualties.

"Boom boom boom!"

When a group of Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes could not be blown up, another group of Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes with a larger number swooped down at high speed and exploded at the same time.

The light attribute energy shield flickered violently, and the light gradually dimmed.

There were no alien army around the light attribute energy shield.

The aliens finally stopped the transmission of the space transmission channel. There were still hundreds of thousands of alien troops in the space where the space transmission channel was located, including the commanders of the army.

It was just that the aliens learned to be smart this time. Among them, there were a large number of five-star alien knights, and their equipment was exactly the same, so it was difficult to distinguish which of them were the real commanders.

In fact, with the perception ability of the five-star Zerg host, some differences between those five-star alien knights could be sensed. In order to let the aliens continue to invest troops, Wu Qing did not let the Zerg Queen attack them.

The space transmission channel of the alien race stopped transmitting reinforcements, which meant that the alien race had admitted defeat. The space transmission channel could be used to transmit in the opposite direction at any time, and transmit the people here back to the rear of the alien race.

"Boom...!"

The Zerg explosive mosquito continued to self-detonate and attack the light attribute energy shield.

The light attribute energy shield was blown up, as if it would be broken at any time, but it did not break, and it still firmly protected the space of the space transmission channel of the alien race.

"This is the power of the gods' rules again, which is equivalent to the gods' disguised attack!"

"Queen of the insects, I wonder if you attack this protective shield, is it a violation?"

Wu Qing asked the queen of the insects helplessly.

"I should be considered a violation if I take action!"

"In this battlefield, it seems that the great powers and those strong men don't have to take action personally. Their power interferes with the battlefield war in other forms, which is not a violation."

"This kind of interference should have a price!"

"Like the spawning ability of the Zerg queen, it has some characteristics of rule-level power. We have been using it, and no strong man has come out to attack us, which shows that this kind of power is allowed to appear."

The Queen of Insects analyzed the large amount of information it had collected and gave Wu Qing an answer that it could not take action, and made a simple explanation.

"Then you don't have to take action, be careful of the final madness of the alien race!"

"If the most important people inside want to retreat, kill 500 of them!"

"I hope there are some big fish among them!"

Wu Qing gave up the idea of letting the Queen of Insects take action.

If the Queen of Insects took action, it would trigger a war between the strong, affecting the overall situation here and not conducive to the rapid development of the Zerg.

Wu Qing knew that the Zerg explosive mosquitoes had the ultimate power and could not break the light attribute energy shield supported by the rule-level power, so he gave up continuing to attack.

A large number of Zerg puppies poured into the light attribute energy shield and the alien army on the battlefield, cutting off the retreat of the alien army on the battlefield.

This area has been cleared due to the impact of the Zerg explosive mosquitoes' self-explosion attack. Fearing that the Zerg explosive mosquitoes would continue to attack, the alien army took the initiative to stay away from this area.

Wu Qing seized this opportunity and let a large number of Zerg puppies rush in.

The attack firepower of the Zerg Destroyer also shifted to this direction, suppressing the counterattack of the alien army and assisting the Zerg dogs to attack the defense line of the alien army.

The alien army on the battlefield had no way out, and it was only a matter of time before they were annihilated by the Zerg army.

The five-star Zerg host in the air noticed that the alien army in the light attribute energy shield was about to retreat, and the five hundred five-star Zerg queens immediately launched an egg-laying attack on the five hundred alien knights selected by the Zerg queens.

The Zerg queen then controlled the control parasites in the bodies of the nearly two hundred five-star human mages, quickly controlled the human mages, and then controlled them to quietly leave the team and come to the edge of the light attribute energy shield.

After a day of recovery, the nearly two hundred five-star human mages already had a certain combat power.

Under the control of the queen, they each cast their best attack magic on the alien army in the light attribute energy shield, then turned out of the light attribute energy shield and left quickly.

The defection of the five-star human mages was a serious matter. Their magic attacks were powerful, causing casualties and some turmoil in the alien human army that was preparing to retreat.

But at this time, the core members of the alien human army had no intention of paying attention to the defection of the five-star human mages. Most of them were attacked by the Zerg Queen's spawning attack.

If you are attacked by the Zerg Queen's spawning attack, there is a risk of self-explosion at any time. Except for the super-strong purification magic driven by divine power, others dare not touch the person who is hit, otherwise they will explode.

The people around can only watch the people who are hit explode one by one, disappearing into light, leaving only equipment and items on the ground.

In the end, the four strongest alien human knights were left, struggling to hold on.

This surprised Wu Qing a little. They could hold on for so long without self-explosion. Their strength is likely to be six-star.

Wu Qing is in urgent need of six-star enemies now. If he can get nine more, the Zerg mother nest can be upgraded!

As Wu Qing expected, the four alien knights finally couldn't hold on and almost exploded to death at the same time.

The number of six-star enemies killed that Wu Qing had been watching turned from 1/10 to 5/10 as he wished!

"Five more to go! I hope we don't have to wait too long!"

Wu Qing was very satisfied with this harvest.

The alien army in the light energy shield finally evacuated through the space transmission channel. After a few transmissions, hundreds of thousands of troops were teleported away, leaving behind an empty space and a large space transmission channel.

Watching this scene through the five-star Zerg host, Wu Qing suddenly had a bad premonition and immediately gave an order to the Queen!

"Keep all the troops away from that protective shield!"

The Zerg troops around the light energy shield immediately evacuated at full speed, and the Zerg puppies who were attacking the defense line of the alien army also retreated quickly from both sides.

The alien army that was fighting with the Zerg puppies seemed to know something about the situation and did not take the opportunity to approach the only evacuation channel.

"Boom...!"

An explosion that was not too loud sounded, and a ball of extremely dazzling white light exploded at the location of the light attribute energy shield, and all the surrounding matter was annihilated and disappeared.

Some Zerg puppies that did not have time to get away were instantly turned into nothingness and disappeared when they were hit by the white light.

This was not the death of the Zerg puppies, but the annihilation of matter!

The white light disappeared quickly, and the location of the light attribute energy shield turned into a huge pit.

The space transmission channel built by the aliens and the surrounding matter were all annihilated and disappeared.
